# 11 - Instructions

Counted from the registries that define it. Run `pnpm census` after changing
a tool, a skill, a prompt, a role, a command or a guardrail;
`tests/docs/census-generated.test.mjs` compares this file against the live
registry, so a stale copy fails the build instead of misleading a reader.

## Agent slash commands (40)

The router `/rule` is pinned first; the rest follow in
locale-alphabetical order. The same set is written for every agent and IDE,
in that host's own format (ADR 034).

Directories are resolved per machine and are not listed here: they depend on
which agents are installed and where their homes are.

| Target                 | Agent      | Format     | Scope   | Prefixes MCP prompts |
| ---------------------- | ---------- | ---------- | ------- | -------------------- |
| Claude Code            | `claude`   | `args`     | global  | yes                  |
| VS Code (Copilot Chat) | `vscode`   | `prompt`   | global  | yes                  |
| Pi                     | `pi`       | `args`     | global  | no                   |
| Gemini CLI             | `gemini`   | `gemini`   | global  | no                   |
| Cursor project         | `cursor`   | `args`     | project | no                   |
| Windsurf               | `windsurf` | `workflow` | global  | no                   |
| Windsurf project       | `windsurf` | `workflow` | project | no                   |
| Cline                  | `cline`    | `workflow` | global  | no                   |
| Cline project          | `cline`    | `workflow` | project | no                   |
| Roo Code               | `roo`      | `plain`    | global  | no                   |
| Roo Code project       | `roo`      | `plain`    | project | no                   |
| opencode               | `opencode` | `args`     | global  | no                   |
| opencode project       | `opencode` | `args`     | project | no                   |

15 more agents get the MCP config but no command files, each for a stated reason:

| Agent         | Why not                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `codex`       | Codex CLI exposes MCP prompts as slash commands itself; its custom-prompt directory is not verified against a published spec, so writing files there would be a guess. |
| `copilot`     | GitHub Copilot CLI gets a custom agent file (~/.copilot/agents); its prompt-file directory is not verified against a published spec.                                   |
| `zed`         | Zed stores its rules/prompt library in profile storage, not in discoverable per-command files.                                                                         |
| `antigravity` | No published custom-command file location; MCP prompts remain the entry point.                                                                                         |
| `kilo`        | Kilo CLI command directory is not verified against a published spec.                                                                                                   |
| `kimi`        | Kimi CLI command directory is not verified against a published spec.                                                                                                   |
| `vibe`        | Mistral Vibe command directory is not verified against a published spec.                                                                                               |
| `grok`        | Grok Build command directory is not verified against a published spec.                                                                                                 |
| `droid`       | Factory Droid command directory is not verified against a published spec.                                                                                              |
| `kiro`        | AWS Kiro command directory is not verified against a published spec.                                                                                                   |
| `qwen`        | Qwen Code command directory is not verified against a published spec.                                                                                                  |
| `jetbrains`   | JetBrains AI Assistant has no user-authored slash-command files; MCP prompts are the only entry point.                                                                 |
| `neovim`      | Editor-level MCP plugins expose prompts directly; there is no command-file convention to write to.                                                                     |
| `emacs`       | mcp.el exposes prompts directly; there is no command-file convention to write to.                                                                                      |
| `devin`       | Devin runs commands in its own workspace runtime, not from local slash-command files; MCP prompts remain the entry point.                                              |

### The kinds (40 commands)

| Kind       | Count | What it is for                                                  |
| ---------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `router`   | 1     | Routes a free-text request to the skill that answers it         |
| `area`     | 11    | Area hub: free text routes to leaf skills/tools (ADR 117)       |
| `workflow` | 2     | Runs a named workflow (e.g. /rule-check auto-detects guardrails) |
| `session`  | 7     | Carries a session across a context boundary                     |
| `persona`  | 19    | Runs one review role at one operation, and writes its documents |

**router**: `/rule`

**area**: `/rule-area-ai`, `/rule-area-backend`, `/rule-area-data`, `/rule-area-devops`, `/rule-area-frontend`, `/rule-area-meta`, `/rule-area-platform`, `/rule-area-process`, `/rule-area-styleguide`, `/rule-area-toolchain`, `/rule-area-ui`

**workflow**: `/rule-check`, `/rule-fix`

**session**: `/rule-compress`, `/rule-handoff`, `/rule-handon`, `/rule-init`, `/rule-stats`, `/rule-update`, `/rule-usage`

The 19 persona commands are one per role and operation
([`13-personas.md`](13-personas.md)).

## Hooks (3 entries across 3 events)

Written into the host's settings file by `install --agent claude`, and
removed by `uninstall`. Every entry carries a marker comment, which is how
a merge and an uninstall find ours without touching anyone else's. Each one
answers `ask`, never `deny`: these are judgment calls with a human in the
room, and a hard block on a false positive costs more than the prompt it
saves.

| Event              | Matcher | Command                              | What it says while it runs                | Timeout |
| ------------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `PreToolUse`       | `Bash`  | `rule-mcp guard bash`          | rule guard: migration and commit checks    | 60s     |
| `SessionStart`     | -       | `rule-mcp guard session-start` | rule: session directive, handoff on resume | 60s     |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | -       | `rule-mcp guard prompt-submit` | rule: prompt directive                     | 60s     |
